title: SUC-04 Churn: declared formula, numerator and denominator with honest missing-data behaviour
risk: The Churn figure is produced under different accounting rules - churn computed from a different cohort, so churn and retention no longer sum to 100% - so the KPI is wrong in the direction that flatters the programme and every decision taken on it inherits the error.
preconditions: Namespace gov-kpi-<case_id>-<worker_id>; the metric is computed by the real reporting code over fixtures/offline/governance.json kpi_dataset and never copied from the dashboard payload.

Frozen clock 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z with the reporting window 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z .. 2026-02-01T00:00:00Z as a half-open interval; the stored aggregate is recomputed independently from the raw counter rows.
Metric scope is fixed before measurement: numerator is customers not returning or cancelling service in the period; denominator is customers at the start of the period.
The dictionary entry for 'Churn' (owner, unit, window, exclusion rule) is loaded read-only and is compared with the recomputation instead of being trusted.

inputs.formula: one minus the retention rate for the same cohort and period
inputs.wrong_value_if_buggy: churn computed from a different cohort, so churn and retention no longer sum to 100%
inputs.expected_boundary_behaviour: no cohort returns NOT_DEFINED, and churn is never published as 0 as a placeholder

steps.action: Compute Churn from the frozen rows in kpi_dataset.retention
steps.expected: The stored aggregate reports 30.0% and records the formula, the window and the currency that produced it.

steps.action: Recompute Churn independently from the raw counter rows for the same tenant and window
steps.expected: The recomputed value equals the stored value 30.0%, and every numerator row lies inside the denominator scope.

steps.action: Force the empty-source variant of the metric (no qualifying row in the window)
steps.expected: The metric reports no cohort returns NOT_DEFINED, and churn is never published as 0 as a placeholder; the display distinguishes missing source data from a measured zero.

steps.action: Read the dashboard payload and the metric dictionary entry
steps.expected: The dashboard renders the stored value with its window, coverage and source, and the dictionary names the owner, unit, numerator and denominator that the recomputation used.

assertions: Churn equals 30.0% for the frozen window, recomputed from the raw counter rows with numerator scope 'customers not returning or cancelling service in the period' and denominator scope 'customers at the start of the period'.

A recomputation that yields churn computed from a different cohort, so churn and retention no longer sum to 100% is detected as wrong: the stored aggregate and the independent recomputation must agree before the figure is published.
The dashboard payload for the same tenant and window carries the stored value with its window, coverage and measurement source; it substitutes neither a design target nor another metric's value.
Boundary behaviour: no cohort returns NOT_DEFINED, and churn is never published as 0 as a placeholder; missing source data is never rendered as a measured zero.
forbidden: Reporting churn from a definition under which churn plus retention differs from 100%.
Treating an unmeasured period as zero churn.
evidence: Churn computation sheet reconciling churn and retention to 100%.
cleanup: Delete gov- aggregate, raw-counter and scenario rows for SUC-04 after exporting the recomputation table.
automation: The reporting service and the metric dictionary run as real code under test over the frozen KPI dataset; the dashboard is a consumer whose displayed value must equal the independently recomputed value. Waits are condition-based on the stored aggregate row, metric values are never supplied as inputs, and no vendor boundary is involved in the arithmetic.
